text: 🇲🇽🛡️ “In the three host venues — very, very well. There hasn’t really been any problem.” — Sheinbaum on World Cup security, mañanera June 19 Three months from kickoff. Zero security incidents reported across CDMX, Guadalajara, Monterrey. Homicides down 46% since September 2024 under the Harfuch strategy. The Mexican government is letting the data answer the panic narrative US media has been pushing for a year.

🇲🇽🐟 “The regulation exists. The question is enforcement.” Thousands of fish killed in the Papaloapan basin, Veracruz. Suspected source: an alcohol distillery in Nopaltepec and companies in Tuxtepec. — Sheinbaum, ordering Profepa into the case, mañanera June 19 NOM-001 — the water-discharge norm — was strengthened under AMLO. Sheinbaum: investigate the causes, sanction the companies. The difference with neoliberalism: the law applies to the polluter, not just the poor.

🇲🇽⚽ “We’re the host nation growing the most — compared to Canada and the United States.” World Cup tourism arrivals: US +3%, Canada -2%, Mexico leading. — Josefina Rodríguez Zamora, Tourism Secretary, mañanera June 19 “La Gran Escapada” — 114,000 discount experiences — opens for the first time to international tourists this weekend. The empire that lectures Mexico on competitiveness is the one losing visitors.

🇲🇽🌎 “It’s not that the treaty ends on July 1. The review process changes.” — Sheinbaum, on the T-MEC sunset clause Trump spent months telling US audiences the treaty would expire July 1. It doesn’t. July 1 triggers the sexenal review, and Mexico is weighing two paths: 16-year extension with broader scope, or 10-year periodic reviews. Ebrard’s team finished the second consultation round this week. 80% of Mexican exports go to the US — and the US production chain depends on Mexico. The leverage runs both ways.

🇲🇽🛢️ Pemex-Petrobras alliance signed next week. The two largest Latin American economies pool ultra-deepwater drilling and ethanol. “We’re not planning to leave the country soon. But it will be signed next week — a Pemex and Energy team is traveling.” — Sheinbaum, mañanera June 19 Petrobras leads the world in pre-salt deepwater extraction. Mexico gets technical transfer for drilling beyond 2,500 meters in the Gulf, plus joint ethanol projects from sugar cane — Brazil’s specialty. South-South energy cooperation, outside the Washington framework.

🇲🇽👑 Sheinbaum will receive King Felipe VI in Palacio Nacional next Thursday. The Conquest is on the agenda. “I will discuss with him what the recognition of indigenous peoples means for Mexico, and what recognizing the abuses of the Conquest means for Mexico.” — Sheinbaum, mañanera June 19 First visit of the Spanish king since AMLO’s 2019 letter demanding an apology — never answered by the Crown. Sheinbaum credited Felipe VI for acknowledging “many abuses” at a March Madrid exhibition on indigenous women. “Not the apology that was requested, but it is progress.”

⚖️🇲🇽 “I don’t think the previous Court would have ruled this way. This is a new Court.” “This speaks to the sensitivity of justices elected by the people. This ruling is genuinely historic.” — Sheinbaum, on the Supreme Court declaring the ABC daycare crimes imprescriptible Unanimous ruling: the 49 children killed and 106 injured in Hermosillo, June 2009, can no longer be shielded by statute of limitations. The popularly-elected Court the right called the end of judicial independence delivered justice on a case the old Court buried for 17 years.

🇲🇽💵 <u>PESO BACKSLIDES TO 17.37 AS FED'S WARSH DEBUTS WITH HAWKISH TONE</u>

The peso slid to 17.37 per dollar on June 19 after Kevin Warsh's first FOMC meeting kept rates at 3.50%–3.75% but the dot plot showed nine of 18 members anticipate at least one more hike before year-end. Dollar index jumped to 100.6, its highest since May 2025. Banxico is now expected to pause its own cut cycle at 6.50%, narrowing the carry-trade differential that has kept Mexican assets in demand.

Warsh is Trump's pick. The Fed is now openly synced to the White House — and a hawkish Fed under a Trump appointee means more imported pressure on the peso every meeting. Sheinbaum's call for a strong domestic market over export dependence is starting to look less like rhetoric and more like an exit strategy.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>ZÓCALO FAN FEST: 576K VISITORS, 322 MDP IN 7 DAYS — MEXICO IS THE WORLD'S HOST CITY</u>

Canaco CDMX: the FIFA Fan Fest at the Zócalo has accumulated more than 576,000 visitors in its first week, averaging 82,400 people per day — making it the most-attended alternate venue of the entire tournament. Economic spillover already past 322.8 million pesos, with each attendee spending between 560 and 1,150 pesos on food and drinks. Canaco projects the full Mundial 2026 will leave 26.28 BILLION pesos in CDMX alone.

Three hosts, but Mexico is moving the crowds. The Zócalo — once the heart of Tenochtitlan — is now the heart of the world's biggest sporting event. Free. Public. Mexican.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>TRUMP'S WEAPON ISN'T A GUN — IT'S CONFUSION, ENGINEERED AT INDUSTRIAL SCALE</u>

Philosopher Fernando Buen Abad in Contralínea (June 17): "Confusion thereby acquires strategic function… Trump understood induced confusion as a decisively destructive force." It's not noise — it's strategy. Constant scandals displace reasoned deliberation with emotional reactivity, dismantling the public's capacity to identify cause and effect or assign historical responsibility for inequality. The infrastructure: tech corporations, media conglomerates, algorithms, data consultancies, all operating at planetary scale.

When Sheinbaum tells reporters Trump is "not well informed" and walks past the bait, she's naming the tactic — refusing to fall into it. Same playbook deployed against Dilma in 2014 Brazil, against Correa in Ecuador, against AMLO before 2018. Mexico has read this book before.
